title: Routing Basics
description: Learn the fundamentals of client-side routing with React Router.

data.text: **React Router** is the standard routing library for React. It enables navigation among views of various components in a single-page application, changing the browser URL and keeping the UI in sync.

data.title: Router Setup

items: **BrowserRouter**: Provides routing context using HTML5 history API
**Route**: Defines a path and the component to render
**Link**: Navigation component (like <a> but doesn't reload page)

data.title: Catch-All Route
data.code:
<Routes>
  <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
  <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
  <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
</Routes>

data.title: Router Types
data.text: BrowserRouter uses clean URLs (/about). HashRouter uses hash URLs (#/about). Use HashRouter when you can't configure the server.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Routes and Route define URL mappings
data.takeaway: Routing is essential for multi-page SPAs. Let's explore nested routes.
